# Contact row — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for the contact row when a contact is one line: avatar-plus-detail that becomes a single button when selectable. `contact` is the adapter shape — id, name, optional detail, photo and tone — so user, driver and group records map onto one row, and the disc tone is picked deterministically from the name, so both renderers agree with no scheme object. Without `onSelect` the row is a plain region, because a row that does nothing must not present as a button; with it the row is one real button, and there are never nested controls — one row, one activation, with actions belonging on the card instead. `trailing` replaces the default chevron with host content, `selected` paints the selected state, and the avatar photo or initials disc stays decorative while the contact's name does the naming.

## Native

### Features

Reach for the contact row when a contact is one line: avatar-plus-detail that becomes a single pressable when selectable — the native twin under the same contract. `contact` is the adapter shape — id, name, optional detail, photo and tone — so user, driver and group records map onto one row, and the disc tone is picked deterministically from the name, so both renderers agree with no scheme object. Without `onSelect` the row is a plain region, because a row that does nothing must not present as a button; with it the row is one pressable, and there are never nested controls — one row, one activation, with actions belonging on the card instead. `trailing` replaces the default chevron with host content, and the row reads its name with detail and selected state.
